description: This file defines a template-based implementation of a Most Recently Used (MRU) cache, including base classes and specializations using std::map and std::unordered_map. It provides methods for inserting, retrieving, peeking, erasing, and managing cache size, with support for different key and payload types.

classes.name: MRUCacheBase
classes.description: Template class implementing core MRU cache functionality with customizable map type.

classes.name: MRUCache
classes.description: Concrete class for MRU cache storing value types, derived from MRUCacheBase.

classes.name: HashingMRUCache
classes.description: MRU cache implementation using std::unordered_map for key-value storage.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates an item in the cache, moving it to the front as most recent.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an item by key and moves it to the front, indicating recent use.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Retrieves an item by key without changing its recency position.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Removes an item from the cache by iterator.

methods.name: ShrinkToSize
methods.description: Reduces cache size to specified limit by removing least recent items.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the cache.
